verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents per-domain renewal control: an auto-renew flag that fires before expiration, plus a manual renewal POST that extends registration immediately. The v2 API also manages notification opt-ins and lets you acknowledge domain lifecycle notifications, which implies expiry alerts but never states it. Nothing in the evidence documents grace or redemption windows after a domain lapses. Missing for 10: documented grace/redemption periods and restore process, explicit expiry-notice timing and channels, independent hands-on corroboration of renewal controls.
